targets.minicex-db: mini-cex SQLite, written by the service (be/db, both stacks open the same file)
targets.kraken-api: Kraken public API, read-only, no key (be/api)
targets.bot: the pure risk gate (be/bot, no network)

meta.note: Generated from features/*.feature by testcases/build.js. Every scenario carries @case:N; an N missing here is an error.

1.title: The store has the documented tables
steps: Then the store has tables assets, pairs, accounts, balances, ledger, transfers, swaps, bridge_ops

2.title: A balance can never be negative
steps: Given a throwaway database with the schema applied
Then inserting a balance with a negative amount fails a CHECK

3.title: A ledger movement is a real, non-zero change with a known reason
steps: Given a throwaway database with the schema applied
Then inserting a ledger row with zero delta fails a CHECK
And inserting a ledger row with reason "bogus" fails a CHECK

4.title: A balance references a real account and asset
steps: Given a throwaway database with the schema applied
Then inserting a balance for a missing account fails a FOREIGN KEY

5.title: A bridge op is unique per direction and external tx
steps: Given a throwaway database with the schema applied
Then inserting two deposit bridge ops with the same external tx fails on the second

6.title: A pair's two legs must differ
steps: Given a throwaway database with the schema applied
Then inserting a pair whose base equals its quote fails a CHECK

7.title: Seeding twice leaves the same rows
steps: Given a throwaway database with the schema and seed applied
Then applying the seed again changes no row counts

8.title: A deposit credits the balance and writes a matching ledger line
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
When "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC
Then the balance row for "alice" in BTC is 1.0 BTC
And a ledger line credits "alice" 1.0 BTC with reason "deposit"

9.title: The ledger sum equals the running balance
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
When "alice" deposits 2.0 ETH
And "alice" withdraws 0.5 ETH
Then the ledger sum for "alice" in ETH equals the balance row

10.title: An internal transfer conserves the total balance
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And a fresh account "bob"
And "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC
When "alice" transfers 0.4 BTC to "bob"
Then the balance row for "alice" in BTC is 0.6 BTC
And the balance row for "bob" in BTC is 0.4 BTC
And the total BTC across "alice" and "bob" is unchanged

11.title: A swap debits the input and credits the net output, both on the ledger
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC
When "alice" swaps 0.5 BTC to USD
Then the ledger sum for "alice" in BTC equals the balance row
And the ledger sum for "alice" in USD equals the balance row
And "alice" has a swap row from BTC to USD

12.title: A bridge withdrawal locks the balance with a debit line
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC
When "alice" bridge-withdraws 0.3 BTC to chain "ethereum"
Then the balance row for "alice" in BTC is 0.7 BTC
And a ledger line debits "alice" 0.3 BTC with reason "bridge_debit"
And the bridge op for "alice" is in status "locked"

13.title: A bridge deposit credits once even when observed twice
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
When a bridge deposit of 1.0 ETH for "alice" from chain "ethereum" with tx "dep-x" is observed
And the same bridge deposit is observed again
Then the balance row for "alice" in ETH is 1.0 ETH
And "alice" has exactly one bridge op with external tx "dep-x"

14.title: An overdrawn transfer leaves both balances untouched
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And a fresh account "bob"
And "alice" deposits 0.2 BTC
When "alice" tries to transfer 5.0 BTC to "bob"
Then the transfer is refused with code "insufficient_funds"
And the balance row for "alice" in BTC is 0.2 BTC
And "bob" has no BTC balance row

15.title: The exchange lists its assets
steps: When the assets are read
Then the asset list includes BTC, ETH, SOL, USD
And every listed asset has a name and a USD price

16.title: The exchange lists its tradable pairs
steps: When the pairs are read
Then the pair list includes BTC/USD and ETH/USD
And no pair has the same asset on both legs

17.title: A quote returns the net after fee
steps: When a quote of 1.0 BTC to USD is requested
Then the quote net equals the gross minus the fee
And the quote fee matches the pair fee in basis points

18.title: Creating an account returns a handle and a token
steps: When a fresh account "alice" is created
Then the response status is 201
And the response has a token

19.title: A duplicate handle is refused
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
When an account is created with the same handle as "alice"
Then the response status is 409
And the response code is "handle_taken"

20.title: A deposit is accepted and shows in balances
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
When "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC
Then the response status is 201
And the API balance for "alice" in BTC is 1.0 BTC

21.title: A swap moves balances by the quoted amounts
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC
When "alice" swaps 0.5 BTC to USD
Then the response status is 201
And the swap response output equals the quote for 0.5 BTC to USD

22.title: A swap below the slippage floor is refused
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC
When "alice" swaps 0.5 BTC to USD demanding at least 1000000.0 USD out
Then the response status is 409
And the response code is "slippage"

23.title: A swap of a delisted asset is refused
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And "alice" deposits 100.0 DOGE
When "alice" swaps 10.0 DOGE to USD
Then the response status is 409
And the response code is "asset_inactive"

24.title: A transfer moves funds between accounts
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And a fresh account "bob"
And "alice" deposits 1.0 ETH
When "alice" transfers 0.4 ETH to "bob"
Then the response status is 201
And the API balance for "bob" in ETH is 0.4 ETH

25.title: A transfer over balance is refused
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And a fresh account "bob"
And "alice" deposits 0.1 ETH
When "alice" tries to transfer 9.0 ETH to "bob"
Then the response status is 409
And the response code is "insufficient_funds"

26.title: A repeated deposit with the same idempotency key makes one credit
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
When "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC with key "dep-1"
And "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC with key "dep-1"
Then the API balance for "alice" in BTC is 1.0 BTC
And the second deposit was an idempotent replay

27.title: An unauthenticated write is refused
steps: When a deposit is attempted with no token
Then the response status is 401

28.title: A bridge withdrawal locks and can be confirmed
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC
When "alice" bridge-withdraws 0.3 BTC to chain "ethereum"
Then the response status is 201
And the bridge op is in status "locked"
When the bridge op is confirmed
Then the bridge op is in status "credited"

29.title: A bridge withdrawal over the cap is refused
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And "alice" deposits 10.0 BTC
When "alice" bridge-withdraws 5.0 BTC to chain "ethereum"
Then the response status is 409
And the response code is "over_cap"

30.title: A bridge to an unknown chain is refused
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC
When "alice" bridge-withdraws 0.1 BTC to chain "mars"
Then the response status is 400
And the response code is "unknown_chain"

31.title: A bridge deposit is idempotent by external tx
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
When a bridge deposit of 2.0 ETH for "alice" from chain "ethereum" with tx "dep-y" is observed
And the same bridge deposit is observed again
Then the API balance for "alice" in ETH is 2.0 ETH
And the second bridge deposit was an idempotent replay

32.title: A swap of an unknown asset is not found
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC
When "alice" swaps 0.1 BTC to ZZZ
Then the response status is 404

33.title: Kraken lists its assets
steps: When the Kraken asset list is read
Then the Kraken asset list is non-empty

34.title: Kraken lists its asset pairs
steps: When the Kraken pair list is read
Then every Kraken pair name is a non-empty string

35.title: The mini-cex crypto assets trade on Kraken
steps: When the Kraken pair list is read
Then a USD pair exists on Kraken for each of BTC, ETH, SOL

36.title: Kraken quotes a positive BTC price
steps: When the Kraken last price for "XBTUSD" is read
Then the Kraken price is a positive number

37.title: The mini-cex BTC price is the same order of magnitude as Kraken's
steps: When the Kraken last price for "XBTUSD" is read
Then the mini-cex BTC price is the same order of magnitude as Kraken's

38.title: Kraken quotes a positive ETH price
steps: When the Kraken last price for "ETHUSD" is read
Then the Kraken price is a positive number

39.title: The kill switch blocks every operation
steps: Given the kill switch is on
When the engine plans a transfer of 0.1 BTC
Then the plan is refused for "the kill switch is on"

40.title: A zero amount is refused
steps: When the engine plans a transfer of 0.0 BTC
Then the plan is refused for "amount must be positive"

41.title: A transfer within balance is allowed
steps: When the engine plans a transfer of 0.5 BTC
Then the plan is allowed

42.title: A transfer over balance is refused
steps: When the engine plans a transfer of 5.0 BTC
Then the plan is refused for "balance is below the amount"

43.title: A swap below the pair minimum is refused
steps: When the engine plans a swap of 0.00001 BTC to USD
Then the plan is refused for "below the pair minimum"

44.title: A swap under the slippage floor is refused
steps: When the engine plans a swap of 0.5 BTC to USD demanding at least 1000000.0 USD
Then the plan is refused for "quote is below the slippage floor"

45.title: A swap with no listed pair is refused
steps: When the engine plans a swap of 1.0 USD to SOL
Then the plan is allowed
When the engine plans a swap of 100.0 DOGE to USD
Then the plan is refused for "no active pair for those assets"

46.title: A bridge to an unknown chain is refused
steps: When the engine plans a bridge of 0.1 BTC to chain "mars"
Then the plan is refused for "destination chain is not supported"

47.title: A bridge over the cap is refused
steps: When the engine plans a bridge of 5.0 BTC to chain "ethereum"
Then the plan is refused for "amount exceeds the bridge per-transaction cap"

48.title: A bridge within cap and balance is allowed
steps: When the engine plans a bridge of 0.5 BTC to chain "ethereum"
Then the plan is allowed

49.title: The home page lists the exchange's assets
steps: Then the assets on screen include BTC, ETH, SOL, USD
And every asset row on screen shows a symbol and a USD price

50.title: A delisted asset is marked so on screen
steps: Then the DOGE row on screen is marked delisted

51.title: The number of assets on screen equals the API asset count
steps: Then the number of assets on screen equals the API asset count

52.title: A funded wallet shows its balance on screen
steps: Given a fresh account "alice" funded with 1.0 BTC
When the wallet page for "alice" is opened
Then the BTC balance on screen is 1.0

53.title: The wallet balances on screen match the API balances
steps: Given a fresh account "alice" funded with 2.0 ETH
When the wallet page for "alice" is opened
Then every balance on screen matches the API balance for "alice"

54.title: A bridge op page shows its status
steps: Given a fresh account "alice" funded with 1.0 BTC
And "alice" bridge-withdraws 0.2 BTC to chain "ethereum"
When the op page for that bridge op is opened
Then the op status on screen is "locked"

55.title: The transfer form moves funds between accounts
steps: Given a fresh account "alice" funded with 1.0 BTC
And a fresh account "bob"
When the transfer form is submitted moving 0.4 BTC from "alice" to "bob"
Then the form result status is 201
And the API balance for "bob" in BTC is 0.4 BTC

56.title: The swap form converts one asset to another
steps: Given a fresh account "alice" funded with 1.0 BTC
When the swap form is submitted converting 0.5 BTC to USD for "alice"
Then the form result status is 201
And the API balance for "alice" in USD is above zero

57.title: The bridge form locks a withdrawal
steps: Given a fresh account "alice" funded with 1.0 BTC
When the bridge form is submitted withdrawing 0.3 BTC to chain "ethereum" for "alice"
Then the form result status is 201
And the form result code is "ok"

58.title: The transfer form refuses an overdraw
steps: Given a fresh account "alice" funded with 0.1 BTC
And a fresh account "bob"
When the transfer form is submitted moving 9.0 BTC from "alice" to "bob"
Then the form result status is 409
And the form result code is "insufficient_funds"
